description: Published lunar locations for geometry studies. Catalog points are not landing-safety recommendations or measurements of surface elevation.
marker_model: Python reference-sphere positions with declared zero elevation; not terrain-clamped coordinates.

sites.name: Apollo 11 landing site
sites.coordinate_notes: NASA NSSDCA Lunar Module coordinates derived from LRO images; planetocentric Mean Earth/Polar Axis lunar reference system, DE421. Published digits do not establish an absolute accuracy guarantee.

sites.name: Shackleton crater reference
sites.coordinate_notes: IAU/USGS Gazetteer crater reference center, published to 0.01 degree, LOLA2011 control network. Planetographic and planetocentric latitude coincide on the lunar spherical reference. Imported as a DE421 context coordinate; precise datum/terrain registration is not certified. This center is not a proposed landing-region boundary or a landing-safety recommendation.
